offlineReplayOfReportedRun.note: User's real Auto edit project of 2026-11-15, rebuilt offline from its voice and reference SRT on a simple 30 fps template; not native.

nativeProbes: Premiere 26.2.2: a marker written to the voice ProjectItem shows on the A2 clip and follows it when the clip is moved or trimmed (#35).
Premiere 26.2.2: setting marker.end in seconds is accepted and shown as a range on the A2 clip (#37).

changes: Caption text keeps the reference SRT when Whisper returns several words with the same start time; the word order is stable and caption ends use the latest word end (#23).
Caption edges are padded by up to 5 frames again in both workflows, without overlapping neighbours (#25).

Inside manual review blocks, the SRT text is restored when ASR differs by exactly one close, non-numeric word (same word count, at least 4 words); such cues get no text marker and never supply cut evidence (#27).
Review markers are one short line 'Cue N: ... – ...' using the caption numbers shown in Premiere (#29).
Picture segments outside the speed warning range get a speed marker on cue-picture plans (#31).
The job folder of the most recent run of each workflow is kept for troubleshooting, without temporary audio (#33).

Review markers are attached to the A2 voice clip and span the warned range; unmappable cases fall back to the sequence ruler. V1 speed and A2 voice clip markers are placed correctly when speed is not 100% (#35, #37).
knownLimitations: Acceptance rests on one real project; other templates, frame rates and speeds are not yet checked.
Voice-clip markers live on the voice media and show in every sequence that uses the same file.
Clip-marker visibility on a nested V1 clip, speeds other than 110%, reverse speed and time remapping are not measured natively; unmappable cases fall back to sequence markers.
Two of the reported cues still show ASR text by design: a proper noun split into two words, and one cell spanning two cues with two differing words.

Six Windows integration groups (installer lifecycle, rollback, panel registry, notification shortcut, native and incident notifications) were not run for this build; no clean-account install test or antivirus scan was recorded.
FFmpeg 8.1.2 source is not attached to the release; THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md links to it (user decision 2026-11-15).

acceptance.basis: User installed 2.20.91 and reran the reported real project with Auto edit; reported no issues found. One project only.
acceptance.promotion: Published as a prerelease, promoted to stable/Latest on the user's request the same day.
